entries: When you don this circlet of gnarled onyx, black barbs dig into your head, imparting power to you as the circlet twists your appearance to amuse the {@deity The Spider Queen|Exandria|TDCSR}. The current resting place of the Circlet of Barbed Vision is unknown, but rumor has it that a spectral assassin known as {@creature Jourrael, the Caedogeist|TDCSR|the Inevitable End} seeks this relic.
name: Circlet of Barbed Vision
reqAttune: by a creature of non-good alignment
